routing_driver_jev_hint: Jev picks who answers each message: fast and cheap.
routing_driver_roundtable_hint: Every bot reads each message in turn and answers only when it has something to add; the leader answers when nobody does. Slower, closer to a real conversation.
routing_driver_judge_hint: A model you choose reads the conversation and picks who answers each message; only those bots run. If it cannot decide, Jev picks.
routing_judge_model_hint: Used by every room that Judge routes. A fast model keeps replies quick.
routing_judge_uses: Judged by {model}, set in the organization settings.
routing_judge_missing: No judge model is set in the organization settings yet, so Jev picks for now.
